newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mostly lower on late selling.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mostly lower on late selling.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed mostly lower after late speculative selling erased midday gains, traders said.
Wheat recovered near midsession from early declines to trade higher, supported by exporter and mill buying. But futures fell late on speculative selling.

Early buying appeared to be exporters pricing the overnight sale of 33,500 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat to Taiwan Flour Mills, traders said. Flour mills were steady buyers throughout the session, even as futures slid late.

USDA crop data released early Friday were slightly bullish for wheat but bearish for corn and soybeans. The steep declines in CBOT corn and soybeans were blamed for pulling wheat lower early. USDA lowered its U.S. wheat crop estimate to 2.282 billion bushels from its September estimate of 2.295 billion bushels.
MGE barley did not trade but December was offered 0.02 cent lower early at $6.97 per cwt.
MGE spring wheat closed down 4-1/4 cents to up one with December off two at $4.18 per bushel. Volume was estimated at 13,857 contracts.
